notes: Ports upstream v1.4.4-v1.5.0: Buddy and the busy indicator recognise Claude Code's new title spinner (a rotating half-circle) alongside the old Braille one, so busy detection keeps working after a Claude Code update. A limit-reset event no longer fires both the on-screen card and a tray notification for the same reset. Clawdmeter moved out of the settings list into its own tab, and table columns can now be resized by dragging their header borders (double-click fits a column to its content); widths are remembered per column.
